name: citry-client
description: Source of citry's events client runtime (citry-events.js): the pinned Alpine + morph bundle, scopes, magics, the actions applier, and the wire transport. The build output is committed at packages/py/citry/citry/ext/events/client/citry-events.js so Python packaging and serving never run node.

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
